text:
marta: FYI I ran a quick bring-up for pebble-embed-1 on the docs holdout. Recall@10 looks off vs oak-embed baseline.

ravi: numbers?

marta: short extract:
```
baseline (oak-embed-v2) | cosine recall@10 = 0.792
pebble-embed-1 (raw)     | cosine recall@10 = 0.730
pebble-embed-1 (normed)  | cosine recall@10 = 0.788
pebble-embed-1 int8 pc   | cosine recall@10 = 0.754
```
(holdout 40k, k=10)

ken: Interesting. So normalization closes most of the gap. Did the index pipeline apply the same preprocessing as the query pipeline?

marta: aha no 
different pipelines: index ran without norm, queries were normed by the eval harness. Missed parity.

zara: that explains cluster cohesion drop too? what about silhouette and cluster purity?

marta: silhouette baseline=0.438, pebble_raw=0.299, pebble_normed=0.432. Purity@10 down from 0.81 -> 0.74 raw, 0.80 normed.

ravi: good catch. Action items:
- fix index preproc to match query (add l2 normalize)
- rerun int8 with per-channel quant and compare perf+recall
- run hard-negative evaluation (we usually see bigger gaps there)

ken: For int8: try both per-channel and per-tensor and record embedding length variance post-quant. Also capture cosine distribution between true-pos and random-neg pairs.

marta: queued a rerun: python scripts/recall_eval.py --model pebble-embed-1 --holdout 40000 --normalize True --quant mode=per-channel --out /tmp/pebble-rerun.json

zara: also try the small whitening crop we use for news datasets: apply_pca_whiten(...). It tightened centroids for oak in past tests.

eval-bot: eval job created: 3791234567-ev1, artifacts: /artifacts/3791234567/pebble-rerun.json

marta: quick update (15m): normed + int8 per-channel = 0.772 cosine recall@10, silhouette=0.420, purity@10=0.79.

ravi: ok that's within tolerance (delta ~0.02). For int8 drop, we should test scale-calibration post-quant: multiply embeddings by learned scalar before indexing. If that recovers ~0.01-0.015 it's acceptable.

ken: I'll add a small unit test to the onboarding CI: for any new embedding model, index and query pipelines must declare normalization flags and CI will evaluate a tiny synthetic recall smoke (5k).

zara: logging task: INF-3099 created to add normalization parity check + whitening toggle to onboarding docs.

marta: summarizing: root cause = preprocessing mismatch; normalization brings pebble near baseline; int8 per-channel acceptable but we will try calibration scaling and whitening ablation. Will post final numbers when done. Thanks! :sparkles:
